The Main Challenge

The real challenge was not collecting donations. It was managing everything around them. A school fundraiser can involve hundreds of participants and many moving parts. Without one central system, organizers had to spend too much time checking records, updating spreadsheets, matching donations, and preparing reports. Before Orange Ruler, campaign setup could take close to 2 days once admin work, participant records, and fundraising details were included. Weekly coordination could also take around 12 hours during active fundraising periods. That workload became even harder when several campaigns were running at once.

Why a Basic Donation Tool Was Not Enough

A basic donation platform could collect money. Orange Ruler needed to do much more. It had to manage campaigns, track students and sponsors, connect donations with the right participant, show progress toward fundraising goals, support school events, and give administrators useful reports. Using separate tools for all of this would have kept the same problem. Someone would still have to connect everything manually. That is why the client needed custom fundraising software.

The School Fundraising Solution

DigiWorks AI developed a custom school fundraising platform that brought campaigns, participants, donations, reporting, and event management into one place. The result was a much cleaner fundraising process for schools and a stronger platform for future growth. The project is a strong example of how custom software development services can replace disconnected tools with one system built around the way a business actually works.

01

Campaign Management

Orange Ruler gives school admins one place to create and manage fundraising campaigns. Goals, participants, donations, and progress stay connected throughout the campaign. Organizers can see what is happening without checking several different systems. The new setup reduced campaign preparation from roughly 2 days to around 3–4 hours.

02

Donation Management

Donations are tied to the right campaign and participant. This makes tracking easier and reduces manual reconciliation. Receipts, payment records, and campaign totals stay connected. During peak fundraising periods, the platform supported 1,000+ donation transactions without forcing organizers to manage payments manually.

03

Participant and Sponsor Management

School fundraising involves students, parents, sponsors, and staff. Orange Ruler keeps that activity organized in one place. This helped reduce weekly admin work from roughly 12 hours to about 5 hours during active campaigns.

04

Real-Time Reporting

Organizers can check fundraising progress while the campaign is still running. They can see donation totals, participant activity, and progress toward goals. Preparing campaign reports dropped from around 3 hours to roughly 20–30 minutes.

05

Event Management

The platform also supports school fundraising events. Campaign data, participant details, and donation activity stay connected during the event. This helped the client support around 15–20 active campaigns at once without the same increase in admin work.

What DigiWorks AI Custom Built

DigiWorks AI developed the platform around the full fundraising process rather than a generic donation page. React.js handled the user-facing experience. Ruby on Rails handled the backend logic and fundraising workflows. AWS provided the cloud infrastructure for growth and heavier campaign traffic.

Why Custom Software Made Sense

The client could have used one tool for donations, another for reporting, and spreadsheets for participants. That would have kept the same gaps. Orange Ruler needed one system built around the full fundraising process, so campaigns, participants, sponsors, donations, reports, and events could stay connected.

Easier to Launch

Campaigns became easier to launch. Schools could start fundraising activities much faster without repeating the same setup work.

Easier to Track

Faster to Report
